name: Building The Church Of God
overview: The Scriptures emphasize that building the Church of God is fundamentally dependent on the Lord's involvement, as Psalm 127:1 declares that without the Lord's building, human efforts are in vain. Jesus affirms this divine foundation in Matthew 16:18, promising to build His church upon the rock of faith, ensuring its endurance against all opposition. The Old Testament passages, such as Exodus 35:20 and 36:3, illustrate the faithful contributions and dedicated service of God's people in constructing the sanctuary, highlighting the importance of willing participation. Furthermore, Matthew 18:19 underscores the power of unified prayer among believers, reinforcing the spiritual unity essential for the church's growth and strength.
